regions.purpose: Identifies the surface and holds the affordance back to Settings.
Read-only header naming which provider is currently the default — answers 'who is resolving Locations right now?' at a glance.
The full provider catalogue the app supports, browsable as a vertical list. Each row presses through to that provider's ProviderConfig.

shows: status pill — configured / not configured / default
affordance icon hinting the row presses through to setup

lists.emptyState: Not applicable — the list always contains every provider type the app implements, including unconfigured BYOK rows. An empty list would mean RTP supports zero providers, which is a build defect, not a user-facing state.
